PROVEN_ROOT_CAUSE:
Executive executeCommand previously bypassed durable SUPRAGrandeMissionRunner admission/correlation.

DEFINED_MINIMAL_CHANGE:
- Executive objectives call existing SUPRAGrandeMissionRunner durable admission.
- Objective request/receipt use the EXISTING Grande Mission INBOX/OUTBOX.
- SUPRAProcessObservatoryStore exposes the correlated Executive objective lifecycle.
- No new engine/runtime/bridge/registry/backend.

DO NOW SEQUENTIALLY:
1) Fetch REQUIRED_APP_COMMIT from PATCH_BRANCH. Verify it descends from c882993d642f8a7cc4adeb989505b7beb09ceb3f and contains only the defined minimal closure plus its direct supporting edits.
2) Build SUPRA at REQUIRED_APP_COMMIT using the existing project/build path.
3) If build fails only because of a direct compile/type error introduced by the defined minimal closure, make only the smallest correction inside the same affected files, preserve the same design, commit it on PATCH_BRANCH, rebuild, and report the corrected installed SHA. Do not redesign or touch unrelated code.
4) Install/update only the canonical $HOME/Applications/SUPRA.app using the EXISTING updater/recovery channel. Preserve rollback.
5) Launch exactly one canonical SUPRA process and prove executable path $HOME/Applications/SUPRA.app/Contents/MacOS/SUPRA.
6) Open SUPRA Executive through the normal existing UI.
7) Submit exactly this ONE natural objective through the Executive text box and Execute button:
"Vérifie l’état actuel de SUPRA et donne-moi la preuve du build installé, sans modifier le système."
Do not inject a synthetic OBJECTIVE_ID from outside; the installed Executive flow must create it.
8) Capture the resulting Executive return.
9) Open/refresh Runtime Observatory and capture the same correlated objective ID and lifecycle from SUPRAProcessObservatoryStore.
10) Prove:
EXECUTIVE_OBJECTIVE -> OBJECTIVE_ID -> RUNTIME_ADMISSION -> EXECUTION -> MATERIAL_RESULT_OR_TRUE_HUMAN_GATE -> EXECUTIVE_RETURN -> RUNTIME_OBSERVATORY.
11) "Running..." alone is FAIL.
12) Stop only on E2E PASS or a TRUE current Human Gate requiring Nicolas.

NEW_ENGINE

NEW_BRIDGE
NEW_REGISTRY
NEW_BACKEND
BROAD_RESCAN
REBUILD_FROM_SCRATCH

PARALLEL_AUTHORITY
